summary: Iteration 41: Verified auto-sync of bank analysis to expenses + calendar, and AI re-categorization endpoint. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed - CSV upload now returns auto_sync + auto_calendar fields with expenses created; GET analysis includes auto_sync; list endpoint projects auto_sync/auto_calendar; duplicate detection works on repeat upload (skipped>0); manual sync-expenses endpoint still functional as re-sync; POST /api/expenses/ai-categorize returns {total, updated_keywords, updated_ai, unchanged, message} and auth is enforced. Frontend: Despesas page shows 'Categorizar com IA' button (data-testid=ai-categorize-btn) - visible, clickable, triggers backend request. Análise Bancária detail loads and 'Sincronizar com Despesas' manual button is present. auto-sync-banner selector exists in code and renders only for analyses with auto_sync data (legacy analyses in DB don't have it, as expected per task notes). Did NOT test real PDF upload (Gemini 3-4 min per task instructions).

issues: Recharts container width/height warnings in console (chart initial render before layout settles) - cosmetic only, no visible impact

critical_code_review_comments: bank_analysis.py _auto_sync_expenses / _auto_feed_calendar (lines 575-726): Correctly reused sync-expenses & feed-calendar logic without requiring auth, called from both PDF background finalize and sync CSV/Excel/OFX path. Duplicate detection uses bank_txn_id set + composite date|amount|supplier key.

bank_analysis.py upload endpoint (line 947): Non-PDF path now runs auto_sync + auto_feed_calendar after computing analysis, and stores results in the analysis document before inserting. Consistent with PDF async path.
bank_analysis.py list projection (line 964): Now includes auto_sync and auto_calendar so frontend list view can show counts without extra fetch.

expenses.py POST /ai-categorize (line 582): Two-phase categorization - keyword matching first (fast/deterministic), then GPT-4o-mini fallback for remaining 'Outros' in batches of 40. Response schema includes total/updated_keywords/updated_ai/unchanged. Only touches expenses where old_cat in ('Outros','','outro','Outro'), so safe to re-run.

Minor: _auto_sync_expenses treats every debit >0 with a matching category as an expense, using the full transaction description as supplier (truncated 100). For very generic descriptions this may create noise in the expenses list - acceptable trade-off given duplicate detection.

Minor: The auto_calendar 'skipped' counter also increments for existing future appointments (correct behaviour), but analyses uploaded multiple times will always show skipped>0 after first run - user may need clarification in UI.
DespesasPage.jsx handleAICategorize: uses toast for success/error and triggers refresh - good UX. Button has proper data-testid.
AnaliseBancariaPage.jsx auto-sync-banner (line 328): Conditionally rendered only when auto_sync exists on the analysis doc - correct guard for legacy records without the field.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (button visible+clickable, banner selector exists, manual sync button still present)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded a synthetic 8-line CSV (test_iter41.csv) with VODAFONE/GALP/LEROY MERLIN/FIDELIDADE + client transfer. All created expenses and the analysis were deleted at test end. Any expenses containing 'test_iter41' in notes were removed.
